actual_external_input.statement: Classical Brody reparametrization: diverging derivatives of holomorphic discs in a compact complex target yield an entire limit with derivative norm 1 at the origin and at most 2 globally.
actual_external_input.independent_location_control: Full-disc slow-base contraction and stable-coordinate oscillation, not a prescribed-point version of Brody.

comparison_only_passages.scope: Winkelmann blow-up example: Brody centers can move. Not an Anosov counterexample.
Ahlfors positive-mass localization variant reviewed but not invoked; its area hypothesis remains unproved here.

proved: Actual constant-rank one-complex-dimensional intersection of two Anosov stable bundles integrates locally to a unique smooth analytic curve germ.
Each specified topological central fibre contains a normalized stable Brody curve and an unstable Brody curve.
Periodic central fibres have a dense set of points with both analytic central stable and unstable plaque germs and independent tangent lines; their union is dense in Y.
countermodel: Explicit noncompact linear holomorphic symplectic hyperbolic map and a Cantor-function triangular quotient, with exact hyperbolic quotient equivariance, stable/unstable entire curves in every fibre, dense Lagrangian analytic pieces and non-complex fibres. No compact lattice or original monodromy.
